sbar.situation: Recovery is not confirmed. The call network's location service (ALI) is down, so every emergency_call journey in dispatch fails at the location step.
sbar.background: The ALI service on call-network stopped answering, and 100% of requests now fail against a 0% baseline. Call-handling logs show 'ALI gave no answer (refused)'. ALI is run by another organisation.
sbar.assessment: The root cause is an external outage on call-network (confidence 0.93). No allowed action could fix it, so the incident commander escalated it to the call network provider itself. Recent changes look like routine tuning and are not the cause.
sbar.recommendation: Follow up with the 9-1-1 call network provider and confirm they are restoring the ALI location service. Until it returns, make sure call-takers get each caller's location verbally, then confirm emergency_call journeys pass the location step again.
